0022600009.text: The Houston Rockets have yet to play a 2026-27 game, while the San Antonio Spurs are 0-1 after losing their only game at home and sit 15th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 0.5 games back. Steven Adams is out for Houston with calf soreness, and for San Antonio Jayden Quaintance is out following knee surgery while Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision. This season's series has no games yet, but in 2025-26 the Rockets lost 1-3, including a 145-120 defeat in San Antonio on March 8, 2026.
